```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```
# Load data
```{r}
sleep_day <- read_csv("data/sleepDay_merged.csv")
minute_sleep <- read_csv("data/minuteSleep_merged.csv")
minute_mets <- read_csv("data/minuteMETsNarrow_merged.csv")
```
# Missing values
```{r}
cat("SleepDay\n")
colSums(is.na(sleep_day))

cat("\nMinuteSleep\n")
colSums(is.na(minute_sleep))

cat("\nMinuteMETs\n")
colSums(is.na(minute_mets))
```
# Duplicates
```{r}
cat("SleepDay:", sum(duplicated(sleep_day)), "\n")
cat("MinuteSleep:", sum(duplicated(minute_sleep)), "\n")
cat("MinuteMETs:", sum(duplicated(minute_mets)), "\n")
```
# Remove duplicates
```{r}
sleep_day <- distinct(sleep_day)

minute_sleep <- distinct(minute_sleep)

minute_mets <- distinct(minute_mets)

cat("SleepDay:", sum(duplicated(sleep_day)), "\n")
cat("MinuteSleep:", sum(duplicated(minute_sleep)), "\n")
cat("MinuteMETs:", sum(duplicated(minute_mets)), "\n")
```
#Summary  
## Sleep day
```{r}
summary(sleep_day)
```

## Minute METs
```{r}
summary(minute_mets)
```

## Sleep efficiency
Calculated as:$\frac{\text{Minutes Asleep}}{\text{Time In Bed}} \times 100$

```{r}
sleep_day <- sleep_day %>%
  mutate(
    SleepEfficiency =
      (TotalMinutesAsleep / TotalTimeInBed) * 100
  )

summary(sleep_day$SleepEfficiency)
```
# Minutes asleep distribution
```{r}
ggplot(
  sleep_day,
  aes(x = TotalMinutesAsleep)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    fill = "dodgerblue",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Total Minutes Asleep",
    x = "Minutes Asleep",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
### Obs
Most users have a typical time asleep but some have unusually low minutes.

# Sleep efficiency Distribution
```{r}
ggplot(
  sleep_day,
  aes(y = SleepEfficiency)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "thistle"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sleep Efficiency",
    y = "Sleep Efficiency (%)"
  )
```
### Obs
Most users have a high sleep efficiency, but there are several outliers.

# MET distribution
```{r}
ggplot(
  minute_mets,
  aes(x = METs)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    fill = "tomato",
    colour = "black"
  )+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of MET Values",
    x = "MET Value",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
### Obs
Mostly lower MET values, so users have large periods of low activity.

# Avg Sleep distribution by user
```{r}
avg_sleep <- sleep_day %>%
  group_by(Id) %>%
  summarise(
    AvgSleep = mean(
      TotalMinutesAsleep,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(AvgSleep)

ggplot(
  avg_sleep,
  aes(
    x = reorder(as.factor(Id), AvgSleep),
    y = AvgSleep
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "peachpuff3"
  ) +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )+
  labs(
    title = "Average Sleep Duration by User",
    x = "User",
    y = "Average Minutes Asleep"
  ) 
  
```
# Dashboard inclusions
- Sleep duration
- Sleep efficiency
- Activity intensities
- Date filters
- Sleep trends
- Activity trends


# Functional Requirements
- Allow users to filter data by date range
- Display activity intensity levels
- Identify nights with poor sleep
- Compare time in bed against minutes asleep
- Display summary stats

# Non-functional requirements
- Provide clear error messages
- Filters work within 5s
- Use accessible colour schemes
- Develop using reproducible R shiny
- Contrast text and background
